description: The menu on the host picker beside New session (the host whose chats are listed), opened by right-click or press and hold at the pointer. Not opened while the picker's own list is open.
opens: right-click or long-press the host picker beside New session

parts.name: Host Command…
parts.shows: "Host Command…", first. Only when the picked host is another machine reached over ssh. Opens HostCommand.dialog.json.

parts.name: Deactivate / Activate
parts.shows: "Deactivate" for the picked host, or "Activate" if it is deactivated. Only for another machine (never for this one). Deactivating greys its chats and shows the banner "<host> is deactivated" over them; the host is not reached while off.

actions.does: Switches the host off or on; a toast says "<host> deactivated" or "<host> activated".

parts.name: Add Host…
parts.shows: "Add Host…" in a section of its own below a separator, always shown, whichever host is picked (even this machine's).

states.name: another host picked, reached over ssh
states.shows: Host Command…, Deactivate (or Activate), separator, Add Host….

states.name: another host picked, not over ssh (a mesh member reached through another)
